title: Master project plan + canonical AI/Agent LEGO architecture
scope: Documentation, declaration and governance. No feature domain was implemented.

relationshipToMain.action: none — main not modified, not merged, not force-pushed

crossAgent.method: read-only git fetch; NOT merged, NOT cherry-picked, NOT reset
crossAgent.finding: Agent 1's vocabulary lock consumes backend vocabulary with provenance and publicationPending records. It does not define a competing vocabulary.

newDeclarations.apps/n8n-lego/src/lego/manifest/ai-lego-: The 15 official AI/Agent LEGO, 6 phases, experiences, concept kinds, external action model, deployment modes, performance rules, security invariants, Rust strategy, current limits. Adds `reconciles` for the 4 LEGO that overlap core domains, and a declared phase-dependency exception.
newDeclarations.apps/n8n-lego/src/lego/manifest/project-: Development workforce (manager/worker authority), job/task model, control planes, 25 decision principles, 6 blockers.
newDeclarations.docs/n8n-lego/decisions/cross-agent-deci: Backend side of the XA-* arbitration record.

generatedDocuments.rule: Generated by tools/lego/ai-pack.mjs from the manifests. Hand-editing is impossible to preserve: writeAll deletes .ai/ before writing and lego:ai:check fails on staleness.

operationCount.verification: manifest/domains.json at commit 6f7b66da declares 82 capabilities and 139 operations — byte-identical to the current tree. The 173 figure was an arithmetic error in prose, not a regression.
operationCount.durableFix: The count is now generated into .ai/master/CURRENT_STATUS.md instead of written by hand.

domainCount.note: No stale '25 domain' claim was found in the tree. The count is now generated in CORE_LEGO_ARCHITECTURE.md and asserted by a test.

manifestDefectsFoundByTheNewTests: 9 of 15 LEGO were missing the `lifecycle` field — added.
`skill` and `mcp-adapter` carried free prose in `versioning` where the vocabulary is `publicationPending` — normalised, with the prose moved to `versioningNote`.
agent-machine (phase B) depends on approval (phase C) — a real forward phase dependency, now declared as an exception with its fail-closed degradation and the phase that closes it.

pinnedVersionTest.is: asserts the MAJOR version and a valid semver
pinnedVersionTest.why: XA-5 legitimately published 11 new codes as a MINOR bump. A pinned exact version makes every compatible addition look like a regression.

scaleOut.verdict: NOT scale-out ready — 2 class-A blockers remain in src/store.mjs (agent-5, P8)

newGateRule.detects: an official AI LEGO sharing a name with (or shadowing behind an `ai-` prefix) a core domain without declaring `reconciles`, a reconciliation naming a non-existent domain, or an owner that is not a declared agent
newGateRule.why: This is the no-second-vocabulary rule made mechanical. Prose cannot fail a build.
newGateRule.proof: 2 selftest fixtures; both fire; negative control stays clean.

negativeProofs: reconciliation requirement rejects a fork (workspace loses `reconciles`)
fabricated version on an unpublished contract is detected
an undeclared concept in a scenario is detected
closing a class-A blocker fails the suite
tests.falsificationRun: Deliberately closed BL-1, marked agent-machine implemented and fabricated ai.memory@1.0.0 — 4 tests failed as designed; tree restored from backup and re-verified green.

invariants.note: The only changed executable code is tools/lego/ai-pack.mjs (generators), tools/lego/foundation-gate.mjs (F17) and two test files. No src/ runtime module was touched.

openForManager: XA-8 — AI permission namespace (backend recommends Option A)

XA-11 — ownership of the 15 LEGO; 12 on manager will bottleneck phase B

notClaimed: a locally available frontend browser gate
an operational Supabase control plane or VPS execution gate — neither has a client, schema or credential in this tree
